title: Filolial Regular Meeting [Part 1]
paragraphs: Three days have passed since we began leveling up on Cal Mira Island. For the past three days, I’ve been hatching and raising the Filolial eggs that Father gave me, just as I please. However, I still haven’t found Filo-tan. There are many chicks with similar colors, but they’re all just a little different. By the way, I gave the same names to the ones I recognized or remembered. Ah, I was surprised to find Ku, Marin, and Midori among them. But my Filolial raising doesn’t stop.

How many have I raised so far? As far as I can recall, I’ve gone over 20. Since it’s the third day, a few of them are starting to take on their angelic forms. With the rapid level-ups, the island is getting livelier.
“Naofumi-san, it was a good thing you arranged for a large ship separately.”
“Yeah, that way the hotel didn’t get too noisy.”

At night, Ren and Itsuki gathered at the central island’s hotel. Father and the soldiers dispatched from Melromarc, along with the earl, were supposed to hold a meeting there. I was invited as well. Well, after finishing my hunts, I had been returning to the central island to check on the Filolials anyway.
“Alright, we could hold the regular meeting here, but I heard there’s a meeting room with a better view. Let’s use that.”
“Father, aren’t you going to the hot spring?”
“Hmm… maybe later? I’d like to finish summarizing the progress report first.”
“Understood.”
We were guided to a meeting room that looked like a round table hall where the Heroes usually held their meetings.
“Well then, I will now begin the progress meeting on the… Filolial breeding situation for the Heroes.”
Since Fiancée isn’t here this time, the soldiers are presiding over the meeting.
Will she be arriving later? Ren and Itsuki look slightly down as they take their seats. As usual, they seem grumpy when they sit at this table.
“Itsuki, you didn’t get scolded for messing up the hunting grounds, did you?”
“I didn’t. I always yield to adventurers when they’re around. But when I went deeper into the island, there weren’t any adventurers, so I had it all to myself.”
“And Ren, did you make the Filolials hunt on their own under the pretext of finding the best hunting grounds? When I came to Cal Mira Island last time, Father scolded me for that.”
“I didn’t. Like Itsuki, I took the Filolials to hunt the monsters deep in the island. They were weaklings thanks to the power of the Hero’s weapon.”
“Actually, practicing coordination with the Filolials was good training, wasn’t it?”
“Yeah, I intentionally used a weaker weapon to practice synchronizing. Éclair helped too.”
“I got help from Kou-san and Sakura-san.”
As for me, I was with Yuki-chan. Father had his assistants and the mole helping him.
A rival, perhaps? Since they would only get in the way of raising the Filolials, they seemed to be playing around freely on the island.
“Naofumi-san, how’s the situation on your end?”
“Hm? Is it okay if I go first?”
“Yes, since it looks like you’re the one collecting the most troublesome statistics, I’d like to use that as a reference.”
“Got it.”
Father stood up and showed us what looked like some documents. It’s pretty thorough.
“Ren, Itsuki, you both know that I’ve been grouping the chicks that have colors similar to Filo separately, right?”
“Yes, we’ve been handing them over to Motoyasu-san.”
“White and cherry blossom colors… I guess there aren’t that many, probably due to the ratio. It’s more like white with a reddish hue.”
“Well, yeah. It’s hard to distinguish them when they’re still chicks. If they have blue eyes, the number shrinks even more… For some reason, they’re all the ones that hatched from my eggs.”
“Even with so many, that’s all you’ve found?”
“It’s a miracle there were even that many. Motoyasu, how are those ones doing?”
“They’re a bit different from Filo-tan…”
The scent, the voice, and even the gender—everything is completely different. On top of that, their feathers had mixed patterns, and once they grew, the patterns changed.
“Well, those ones were… I guess you could say they weren’t the right ones.”
“What have you been doing, Naofumi-san?”
“I’ve been working with the breeder to study their diet. We’ve been comparing the Filolials that ate only the nutritional food prepared by the breeder and those that ate only the island’s monsters.”
“Come to think of it, Filolials do have a characteristic where their traits change depending on their diet and environment, right?”
“Yeah.”
“…Was Imia okay?”
Ren suddenly brought up the mole.
Why bring up the mole in this situation? Father nodded slowly.
“Well… it was a bit dangerous, but she was fine. Imia-chan herself has gotten stronger, and Windia-chan protected her…”
“Seriously, Filolials are such ferocious creatures.”
“What did you say!?”
“Motoyasu, it’s true. Just like with Kou, someone must have targeted Imia.”
Ugh… To think that the curiosity of the Filolials would bare its fangs here and lower Father’s reputation…
This Motoyasu is extremely frustrated.
“So, what was the result?”
“The ones that ate only the nutritional food were healthy… or rather, they didn’t show any particularly notable traits.”
“The way you said that makes it sound like the ones that ate the island’s monsters were different.”
“…Yeah, kind of.”
When I raised a large number of them on Cal Mira Island last time, a lot of things happened. Maybe similar changes occurred this time too.
“First, there are monsters on the island like Violet Blob, Magenta Frog, Yellow Beetle, and Cactus Worm. The Filolials that regularly ate these monsters showed slight changes in their fur.”
“Their color changed too?”
“Just a little. The tips of their feathers took on the color of the respective monsters. And it looked like they slightly absorbed the characteristics of the monsters they matched.”
What! To think such results would come out…
The mysteries of the Filolials are still far from being unraveled!
“Filolials have such traits?”

“It’s still within the range of individual differences, though. For example, Filolials that preferred eating Magenta Frogs liked singing and had higher jumping ability. Sometimes, their cries even sounded a bit like a frog’s.”
“What about the Violet Blob?”

“They seemed to have unusually flexible bodies. The Yellow Beetle ones had harder feathers on their heads. As for the Cactus Worms, they tended to run with a lower posture. But it’s only minor differences like that.”
“Is their nutrition okay?”

“According to the breeder, there’s no problem. I’ll keep feeding them a variety of things and observe, but it seems that whatever they eat before becoming fully grown affects them. Once they can transform into angels, though, what they eat doesn’t seem to matter anymore.”
Father is a perfectionist. That’s probably why he’s researching this in such detail. All Filolials are angels, after all.
“Maybe the boss-class monsters in the depths of the island impart similar traits? Itsuki and Ren, since you were working over there, do you know anything about that?”
“Now that you mention it… I fed them Karma Squirrels, but do Filolials have cheek pouches? They were storing food in them.”
“I fed them Karma Dogs, and they seemed strangely inclined to coordinate their cries.”
Oh, so these traits can vary that much? This is the first time I’ve heard about it.
“It’s only a vague observation, though. Filolials are really deep creatures.”
“Maybe… it’s also about their personalities? What do you think? Should we check that later?”
“That might be a good idea. In my case, I’m afraid of my companions going berserk.”
“Yeah. I wouldn’t want them to have personalities like the ones in Motoyasu’s stories.”
Ren and Itsuki seem to be carefully educating their Filolials based on my stories. But Filolials generally have bright, fun-loving personalities. That’s proof that they’re angels.
“Honestly, after these three days, I feel like I’m on the verge of parental burnout from all the stress.”
“Now you understand Naofumi’s struggles.”
“Even if I do… So, I think some of them should have transformed into angels by now. How’s that going?”
At Father’s suggestion, Itsuki and Ren straightened their backs and addressed me and Father.
Oh? Is something going on?
“That’s exactly it. We’ve made an astonishing discovery!”
“Yeah, me too.”
“What is it?”
“Well, I have a vague idea…”
It seems Father already has an idea of what Ren and Itsuki are going to say.
“I was watching Yuki-san, Kou, and Sakura-san, so I assumed that when Filolials transformed into angels, they would take on a younger appearance, but—”
“One of the Filolials I raised has grown tall! From how it talks, it seems more mentally mature too.”
Ren interrupted and spoke over Itsuki. Itsuki nodded in agreement.
“I was just about to say the same thing.”
